_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Thirtieth scheduled run, closing the week. 16 of 20 URLs served -- full coverage of every site with a product feed for the third consecutive day -- and 9,960 product pages reviewed.

One new case, and the first against a Registered mark since September: HUNIUROSEG-021, "Germany Tantau Baronesse" at Huniu Rose Garden, matching BARONESSE (Reg. No. 7593983, Rosen Tantau KG), listed at 29.99 USD as a 2027 preorder. Huniu grew 297 -> 298 and this was the addition, so it is a genuinely new listing. Captured the same morning.

The classification is Possible, because that rating is decided mechanically: a single ordinary word inside a longer title can be coincidence. An investigator note on the case records what the rating cannot see -- the listing names Rosen Tantau, the registered owner of the mark, alongside it. That is a fact about the listing for a human to weigh, not a finding of infringement, and the classification was left at Possible rather than overridden.

The same seven listings remain removed, each re-confirmed by HTTP 404 on its own URL. 376 of 383 cases re-verified; nothing left unchecked. Flower Meadow Dream shrank 221 -> 217, and none of the four listings that left was a tracked case.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.
Served at 217 products, down from 221 on 2026-10-22. MYROSEWORL-001..003 remain removed (HTTP 404); none of the four listings that left was a tracked case.
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served at 165 products. HILLSIDERO-004 and -005 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Served at 298 products, up one from 2026-10-22. The new listing matched a chart name and became HUNIUROSEG-021 (BARONESSE, Registered) -- the first new case against a Registered mark since 2026-09.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.

Reached on the apex host after the www host was refused by the egress proxy. The Shopify feed returned HTTP 200 with an empty product array -- the store genuinely lists no products. Counted as checked, zero products.
Served at 62 products, unchanged. KATEROSES-001 and -002 remain removed (HTTP 404).

screenshot_limitation: 331 of 383 cases carry a screenshot, including HUNIUROSEG-021 captured today. The 52 without one each record why: High Garden 46 (7 Registered) -- the seller's pages blank themselves on detecting an automated browser, so these need manual capture and the measure was not bypassed; One Love 3 -- a membership login wall, also not bypassed; Flower Meadow Dream 3 -- listings removed, HTTP 404.
